smileProject.title: Projects / Smile Checkup
smileProject.name: Smile Checkup
smileProject.description: Smile Checkup is a healthcare platform that allows users to discover and compare medical services and promotional offers across various specialties, including ophthalmology (LASIK, LASEK, cataract surgery, etc..), dentistry, dermatology, plastic surgery, and comprehensive health checkups. The application provides features such as nearby hospital search, hospital comparison, notifications for bookmarked hospital events, and corporate health checkup inquiries.
smileProject.problemAndSolution:
Although the mobile application had already been developed before I joined the project, its architecture lacked proper state management, reusable components, and a clear separation of business logic. As a result, the codebase was difficult to maintain and extend.

After gaining a thorough understanding of the application's core features, I began a complete refactoring of the project. This included redesigning the state management architecture, improving the routing structure, separating UI from business logic, and introducing reusable components. Within approximately three months, the application had been fully refactored into a maintainable codebase, allowing new features to be developed more efficiently.

The backend and database schema were also redesigned to improve scalability and support future feature development. On the administrative side, I implemented a clear separation between system administrators and hospital administrators, along with a content approval workflow to validate uploaded content before publication. Finally, I designed and developed a dashboard and analytics system to provide insights into user behavior and application usage, enabling more informed product decisions.
